correctness.rationale: PASS. The embedded affine recurrence Z=aZ+aB_E gives the infinite product, while stationary active/refractory weights produce the exact mixture (shape-independent for finite E[R]); normalization d=D/r and w=r E[R]/(1+r E[R]) checked. Frullani yields the symmetric Lévy density with K(t)=sum_{j>=0} exp[-t/(a^j sqrt d)]-exp[-t/sqrt(wd)]. K is pointwise nonnegative because its j=0 term dominates the subtracted term, with logarithmic near-zero growth and exponential tails; thus Lévy integrability holds. The classical Sato radial-profile monotonicity criterion implies SD iff K is decreasing. At w=a^(2m), the j=m term cancels; at a=1/100,w=a^(2m+1), at s=a^m/10, scaled derivative obstruction has negative term 10/e and positive sum bounded by 100/99+200e^-10<2; hence K prime>0, all m>=1. Exact cumulant formula and odd vanishing consistent. Independent finite check for m=1,2,3 verified the strict bound numerically; it is not the infinite proof. w=0 convention and tau=0 endpoint accounted for.

value.rationale: PASS. A stationary stochastic resetting model has a natural divisibility hierarchy relevant to Lévy-driven representations and AR laws. The property of all-occupancy infinite divisibility alongside alternating self-decomposability in arbitrarily small positive occupancy is a sharp, non-obvious qualitative boundary, not just routine cumulant computation. It gives explicit parameter witnesses rather than an unsupported full phase diagram.

limitations: One-dimensional driftless Brownian active motion, exponential active epochs, independent finite-mean refractory holding. Interlaced geometric occupancy sequences are witnesses, not a complete SD phase diagram; positive-w novelty not historically certified.
